facts.text: Serve the mains when Declan serves dinner at his pub in Dingle.
facts.why: The dinner scene is at the Tipperary bed and breakfast, where Anna and Declan pose as a married couple. Declan runs the pub in Dingle but is not shown serving dinner there.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Anna and Declan have dinner at the Tipperary B&B.

facts.text: Jeremy waiting with a ring she wanted
facts.why: Jeremy gives Anna earrings, not the ring she hoped for, and only proposes later in the Dublin hotel lobby. No scene has him waiting with a ring.
facts.fix: Jeremy with earrings, not the ring
